Package com.csse3200.game.encounters.integration

Class PlayerDeckAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.encounters.integration.PlayerDeckAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
DeckGateway
public final class PlayerDeckAdapter extends Object implements DeckGateway
Connects Team 2 shop transactions to Team 5's persistent player deck.

      public boolean canAddCard(String cardId)
      Description copied from interface: DeckGateway
      Checks whether the persistent deck currently accepts a card.

      The default keeps existing adapters compatible. Production deck adapters should override this method when they enforce registered-card, duplicate, or size rules.

      Specified by:
